listing.name: Sardaukar
listing.summary: Adds a neutral but hostile fleet of fanatical Sardaukar ships that spawn in Corvus at the start of a new game.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a neutral but hostile fleet of fanatical Sardaukar ships that spawn in Corvus at the start of a new game.

description:
These are the remnants of a fanatical army called the 'Sardaukar', once employed by a once powerful and now destroyed empire.

Ruthless and arrogant, they hopelessly hold on to past honour and glory; they consider most other factions to be beneath them.

aiDescription: Adds a neutral but hostile fleet of fanatical Sardaukar ships that spawn in Corvus at the start of a new game. They are arrogant and aggressive, flying without a cause and waiting for a worthy leader to serve. The fleet includes a variety of ship types from interceptors to a carrier.
